data.title: 诗怀雅 · 私人游艇甲板的香槟假日
data.action: 翘着二郎腿靠在真皮软垫贵宾椅上，推起墨镜露出金琥珀般的虎目，一手端着冒泡的冰镇香槟杯，得意洋洋地扬起下巴，虎尾在躺椅边缘轻快地拍打
data.location: 泊在珊瑚海上的顶级私人豪华游艇前甲板
data.lighting: 夕阳落日熔金的金色反光照亮发丝与香槟气泡
data.mood: 骄傲自信、贵气洒脱、元气大小姐
data.description: 晚霞镀金的珊瑚海域豪华游艇。诗怀雅身着维多利亚名媛奢金祖母绿分体泳衣，墨镜推上额头。她靠在真皮软榻上晃动着金黄香槟，虎尾轻快地甩动着，骄傲扬起下巴邀请你入座，周身洋溢着龙门富家千金独有的明媚豪爽与贵气活力。
data.promptProse: Swire reclines cross-legged on a cream leather daybed across the teak foredeck of her private yacht at sunset, wearing a jewel emerald velvet high-waisted bikini with spun-gold trim, gold chain clasps, and a sheer silk sarong. With designer sunglasses pushed onto her head and a sparkling champagne glass raised, she flashes a proud, radiant grin into the golden-hour glow.
data.animaCaption: Lounging cross-legged on a cream leather daybed aboard her teak yacht deck in an emerald-and-gold high-waisted bikini, she pushes sunglasses up onto her head and lifts a sparkling champagne flute with a proud grin. Molten sunset light rims her hair and the open sea behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a rich emerald-green velvet high-waisted bikini trimmed with metallic gold embroidery, gold chain clasps, and a sheer silk sarong.
